reviews.comment: Dr. Dworkin is a very understanding and caring professor. He cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

Professor Dworkin is my favorite professor so far at Texas A&M. His class is fun and really easy. Yes, you have to read, as it is an upper level course. But he makes the assignments easy and he is very accommodating to students. He is passionate about his subject and the books he assigns are really good bad. You have to be really lazy to not get A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Dworkin is a really good professor who genuinely wants his students to succeed in the course. There are journals due every week over the assigned ready, but they are mainly just completion grades. The essays and final project are pretty straightforward. The readings are also interesting and make it is easy to have good discussions.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: You can tell he's really passionate about what he teaches, and if you put in the effort for your grade you'll get the grade you deserve. Make sure you do all the essays and journals, and definitely go to office hours. He genuinely wants his students to succeed and he'll help you out if you put in the effort. Altogether a very solid professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He makes you work for the grade, I won't lie,,,but he is extremely thorough with feedback on major work and genuinely wants his students to succeed. Lectures consisted of group discussion of journals submitted the night before, and he encouraged students to open up and participate in groups.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Assigns way too much reading for every single class. There is 1 exam and 2 papers. The exam is over 15+ readings that you do in class, he gives you a random quote and you have to identify who the author was and the name of the piece of work as well as what Dworkin thought of the quote. VERY broad essay prompts and gives very little feedback.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. Dworkin's class. There is a lot of reading, but the materials are interesting and very diverse. The class is discussion based, and requires participation. You can tell that he is passionate about the works read in class. Overall a very fun class if you participate and show up. My only complaint is that he speaks a bit quietly.

He gives you a very short amount of time to read a LOT of pages in the books. You have to write a journal weekly, which is not hard but easy to forget to do. If you expect to get a good grade, you CANNOT miss class, EVER. Very discussion heavy, so input into the discussion even if you really don't know what's going on.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great Professor! It's obvious he really cares about the material. He really appreciates good points in discussion. Offers extra credit. Attendance is mandatory, but he rewards you for it. 2 written test, 2 essays, and some other little stuff is what your grade is composed of. He's a really great teacher, i've never seen him in a bad mood.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.
